proposal.motivation: LiAl(SiO3)2 (mp-aaabfuqq) had the lowest penalty (0.147, bin 7). Penalty rose with Li content on the aluminosilicate framework (Li5Al(SiO4)2 at 0.533), and Al-bearing products dominated the aluminosilicate contacts.
